_readme: A dated snapshot of main at `commit` (as_of: the newest capture it reads), written by kb/_program_requirements_heading_agreement.py from the files the tree commits (git ls-files). Rewritten by a dispatch of harvest-gap-census.yml beside the gap census; nothing gates a PR on its freshness, so it can trail the records. Each record's own heading (program.section_heading) against the program it is filed under (sources.json: COCI title and award). check_would_fail_passing counts the records that pass on the committed files (passes_live) whose heading names another award type (heading_award_check, in no pass rule). award_not_program counts headings that name an award and none of the program's title words, set aside (Pasadena's one page for an A.S. and its certificate).
